title: The Unofficial Locker
author: Ulyana Amberdale
blurb: Ines Marchetti, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
